# Calm Smiles Oklahoma

> A free Oklahoma dental directory and patient resource for people with dental anxiety. The site helps patients find anxiety-friendly clinics, compare insurance and comfort features, and prepare for a calmer first call or appointment.

Calm Smiles Oklahoma is designed for anxious patients, caregivers, parents, and Oklahoma dental offices. The directory can be searched by city, Oklahoma region, insurance, SoonerCare / Oklahoma Medicaid, pediatric care, sedation or nitrous options, low-cost options, trauma-informed care, and sensory-friendly features.

Patients should verify insurance participation, services, comfort options, and appointment availability directly with each clinic before scheduling. This website is a directory and educational resource, not medical, dental, legal, or insurance advice.

## Core pages

- [Search Oklahoma dental clinics](https://oklahomadentalclinics.com/): Main clinic directory with filters for city, region, SoonerCare, insurance, pediatric care, sedation, low-cost options, trauma-informed care, and sensory-friendly features.
- [Patient resources](https://oklahomadentalclinics.com/patient-resources.html): Hub page linking to guides for dental anxiety, SoonerCare, sedation, pediatric anxiety, Tulsa dental anxiety, and calling scripts.
- [Dental anxiety guide](https://oklahomadentalclinics.com/dental-anxiety-oklahoma.html): Practical Oklahoma guide for choosing an anxiety-friendly dentist and knowing what comfort features to ask about.
- [SoonerCare dentist guide](https://oklahomadentalclinics.com/soonercare-dentist-oklahoma.html): Questions patients can ask when looking for Oklahoma dental offices that may accept SoonerCare or Oklahoma Medicaid.

## Patient guides

- [What to say to a dentist about anxiety](https://oklahomadentalclinics.com/what-to-say-dental-anxiety.html): Copy-and-edit scripts for anxious patients calling or messaging a dental office.
- [Tulsa dental anxiety help](https://oklahomadentalclinics.com/tulsa-dental-anxiety.html): Tulsa-area landing page for patients looking for anxiety-friendly dental care.
- [Sedation dentist questions](https://oklahomadentalclinics.com/sedation-dentist-oklahoma.html): Questions about nitrous oxide, oral sedation, IV sedation, cost, safety, and transportation.
- [Pediatric dental anxiety guide](https://oklahomadentalclinics.com/pediatric-dental-anxiety-oklahoma.html): Parent and caregiver guide for helping children with dental anxiety.

## Site information

- [Full AI-readable site context](https://oklahomadentalclinics.com/llms-full.txt): Extended description of the site, audience, pages, and important caveats.
- [XML sitemap](https://oklahomadentalclinics.com/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable list of indexable pages.
- [Robots file](https://oklahomadentalclinics.com/robots.txt): Crawler permissions and sitemap location.
- [Humans file](https://oklahomadentalclinics.com/humans.txt): Human-readable site purpose and contact information.
- [Security contact](https://oklahomadentalclinics.com/.well-known/security.txt): Standard contact file for security reporting.

## Optional

- [Dental DJ](https://dental-dj.onrender.com/login): External music-related project intended to help some dental offices make the operatory environment feel calmer for patients.
- [Suggest a clinic](https://oklahomadentalclinics.com/#connect): Form link area for patients, caregivers, or clinics that want to suggest or update a listing.
